slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Your Everlasting Word
Is the eternal source of life
You spoke Your Word
The mountains and the hills sprang out
The valleys took their levels below
The oceans took their depths
Within their boundaries and waters like a gusher

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Filled their depths from the eternal fountains of Your Word,
The everlasting source that never runs dry

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: In You was life, and the life was the light of men
You are the Sun of Righteousness
The glorious Bright Morning Star
The Daystar that shines in our hearts, You are
The Holy Lamb of God
The timeless treasure of all ages

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: You dwell in the mountains of eternal glory
The depths of Your presence is larger than life

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: The width of Your presence goes beyond eternity
That only the eyes of faith can discover,
And a heart of gratitude can enjoy

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: You called forth the firmament
Filled it with endless treasures of Your Word
The everlasting source that never runs dry

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: In You was life, and the life was the light of men
You are the Sun of Righteousness
The glorious Bright Morning Star
The Daystar that shines in our hearts, You are
The Holy Lamb of God
The timeless treasure

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: You’re the Beginning and End of all things
You are the Ancient of Days, who rules eternity
You’re the Beginning and the End of all things
You are the Ancient of Days, who rules eternity
